_comment: Shader effect template library. Each entry defines a named visual-processing archetype with WGSL and GLSL code skeletons, semantic tags for Vibe matching, default parameter values, and performance metadata. The ast_builder.py module uses these templates as starting points before the LLM refines and combines them. Tags are matched against the parsed Vibe intent to select the closest archetype.

templates.name: Passthrough
templates.description: Identity shader — outputs the input texture unmodified. Used as a base for composition and as a fallback when no archetype matches.

templates.name: Chromatic Aberration
templates.description: Splits the RGB channels by a small UV offset to simulate lens dispersion or a degraded optical signal.

templates.name: Vignette
templates.description: Radial darkening toward screen edges. Focuses attention on the centre and adds a cinematic or vintage quality.

templates.name: Film Grain
templates.description: Per-frame pseudo-random luminance noise simulating photographic film grain or analog sensor noise.

templates.name: Gaussian Blur
templates.description: Separable 9-tap Gaussian blur. Produces soft focus, dreamy diffusion, or a base for bloom effects.

templates.name: Glitch / Scanline Tears
templates.description: Time-varying horizontal UV displacement on random rows simulating corrupted broadcast signal or VHS tape dropout.

templates.name: Sepia / Vintage Tone
templates.description: Luminance-weighted sepia colour matrix combined with a contrast boost for a warm, aged photographic look.

templates.name: Ripple / Water Surface
templates.description: Animated 2D sine-wave UV distortion simulating light refraction through rippling water.

templates.name: Pixelate / Mosaic
templates.description: Reduces apparent resolution by snapping UV coordinates to a grid, producing a mosaic or retro pixel-art look.

templates.name: Sobel Edge Detection
templates.description: Highlights edges by computing the Sobel gradient magnitude. Produces sketch, outline, or wireframe aesthetics.
